passive.name: Contentment
passive.text: Increases the wearer's Break Effect by **60/70/80/90/100%**. After the wearer uses Ultimate to attack enemy targets, inflicts the targets with the "Woefree" state, lasting for **2** turn(s). While in "Woefree," enemy targets take **10/12/14/16/18%** increased DMG. The effect of increasing DMG taken is additionally boosted by **8/10/12/14/16%** if the wearer's current Break Effect is **150%** or higher.

passive.name: Enjoy With Rapture
passive.text: At the start of the wearer's turn, regenerates **8/10/12/14/16** Energy for a randomly chosen ally (excluding the wearer) whose current Energy is lower than **50%**.

passive.name: Mutual Healing
passive.text: Increases the wearer's Energy Regeneration Rate by **8/10/12/14/16%** and increases Outgoing Healing when they use their Ultimate by **12/15/18/21/24%**.

passive.name: Hypothesis
passive.text: Increases the wearer's Break Effect by **24/30/36/42/48%**. After using Basic ATK, restores HP for the wearer by an amount equal to **2/2.5/3/3.5/4%** of Max HP plus **800**.

passive.name: Farewell
passive.text: Increases the wearer's Outgoing Healing by **12/15/18/21/24%**. When an ally target's current HP percentage is greater than or equal to **50%**, increases the DMG dealt by **12/14/16/18/20%**.

substatLine: SPD (until the desired breakpoint) > BREAK% >= ATK%
tracePriority: Sylvan Smoke (A4) > Ember's Echo (A6) > Vermilion Waft (A2)

entries.name: Votive Incense
entries.text: Deals Fire DMG equal to **100%** of Lingsha's ATK to one designated enemy target.

entries.name: Smoke and Splendor
entries.text: Deals Fire DMG equal to **80%** of Lingsha's ATK to all enemies and at the same time, restores HP equal to **14%** of Lingsha's ATK plus **420** for all allies. Fuyuan's action advances by **20%**.

entries.name: Dripping Mistscape
entries.text:
Inflicts "Befog" on all enemies. While in "Befog," targets receive **25%** increased Break DMG, lasting for **2** turn(s).
Deals Fire DMG equal to **150%** of Lingsha's ATK to all enemies, and at the same time restores HP equal to **12%** of Lingsha's ATK plus **360** for all allies. Fuyuan's action advances by **100%**.

entries.name: Mistdance Manifest
entries.text:
When using Skill, summons "Fuyuan," with an initial SPD of **90** and an initial action count of **3**.
When taking action, "Fuyuan" launches Follow-Up ATK, dealing Fire DMG equal to **75%** of Lingsha's ATK to all enemies. Additionally deals Fire DMG equal to **75%** of Lingsha's ATK to one random enemy, and this DMG prioritizes targets that have both Toughness greater than 0 and Fire Weakness. Dispels **1** debuff(s) from all allies and restores HP equal to **12%** of Lingsha's ATK plus **360**.
"Fuyuan's" action count can accumulate up to **5**. When the action count reaches 0 or when Lingsha is knocked down, "Fuyuan" disappears.
While "Fuyuan" is on the field, using Skill can increase "Fuyuan's" action count by **3**.

entries.name: Wisps of Aurora
entries.text: After using Technique, immediately summons Fuyuan at the start of the next battle and inflicts "Befog" on all enemies, lasting for **2** turn(s).

entries.name: Vermilion Waft
entries.text: Increases this unit's ATK or Outgoing Healing by an amount equal to **25%**/**10%** of Break Effect, up to a maximum increase of **50%**/**20%** respectively.

entries.name: Sylvan Smoke
entries.text: When using Basic ATK, additionally regenerates **10** Energy.

entries.name: Ember's Echo
entries.text: While "Fuyuan" is on the field and any ally character takes DMG or consumes HP, if a character in the team has their current HP percentage lower than or equal to **60%**, "Fuyuan" will immediately launch the Talent's Follow-Up ATK against enemies. This does not consume Fuyuan's action count. This effect can trigger again after **2** turn(s).

entries.name: Bloom on Vileward Bouquet
entries.text: Lingsha's Weakness Break Efficiency increases by 50%. When an enemy unit's Weakness is Broken, reduces their DEF by 20%.

entries.name: Leisure in Carmine Smokeveil
entries.text: When using Ultimate, increases all allies' Break Effect by 40%, lasting for 3 turn(s).

entries.name: Shine of Floral Wick
entries.text:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

entries.name: Redolence from Canopied Banquet
entries.text: When Fuyuan takes action, restores HP equal to 40% of Lingsha's ATK for the ally target whose current HP is the lowest.

entries.name: Poise Atop Twists and Turns
entries.text:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

entries.name: Arcadia Under Deep Seclusion
entries.text: While "Fuyuan" is on the field, reduces all enemies' All-Type RES by 20%. When "Fuyuan" attacks, additionally deals 4 instance(s) of DMG, with each instance dealing Fire DMG equal to 50% of Lingsha's ATK and 5 Toughness Reduction to one random enemy. This prioritizes targets with both Toughness greater than 0 and Fire Weakness.
